full_installer_acceptance.scope: Diagnostic candidates: native deb install/launch/remove and extracted portable AppImage launch. Final release artifacts are rebuilt and validated separately.
full_installer_acceptance.cli_validation_limit: The diagnostic verifier only checked exit status for the CLI and MCP module invocations. Its CLI invocation was subsequently found to call a module without a main entry point. CLI behavior is not established by this diagnostic; final release verification separately requires meaningful help output from the corrected module and both supplied launchers.
